name: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company
summary: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells building materials in China. It operates through Light Building Material, Water-Proof Building Material, and Coatings and Building Material divisions.
